'''Niosa Bliana''' was a twelve-year [[Human/Legends|Human]] girl who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A [[Thief/Legends|pickpocket]], Bliana had connections to the [[black marketeer]] [[Suraya]] and [[Tasari]] guide [[Valjak]]. The young girl would try to sell treasure maps and act as a guide to newcomers, and would attempt to pickpocket those who did not pay for her services.<ref name="J15" />
